integrity: Standalone analytical proof plus independently implemented finite-state and Fourier-resolution consistency checks. No independent audit; no claim of new finite-time generating function or source recurrence theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exchange coin only; per-step monitoring of position zero; the source supplies the exact original first-return generating matrix and the recurrence probability. The added theorem analyzes fixed-positive-noise asymptotics and a conditional joint small-noise/long-time scaling. Generic coins, unmonitored return, and finite-sample robustness are unproved.
title: A rare-noise Bessel crossover for monitored quantum-stochastic first returns
